title: Missing recursive dependencies
summary: Installed distribution metadata declares Requires-Dist dependencies. Missing transitive requirements can break an application even if its top-level distribution is present. Extras can add further dependency edges.
checks: Compare declared requirements and recursively activated extras against local dist-info metadata.
Check declared base Python compatibility and dependency markers before attributing an import failure.
limitations: Metadata describes installed distributions, not import success, package contents or external services.
applicability: POSIX CPython venv metadata for Python 3.11-3.14; static evidence only
